reads: SELECT current_schema()

SELECT n.nspname, c.relname, c.relkind, c.reltuples::bigint FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm', 'f') AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg\_toast%' AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg\_temp%' AND NOT c.relispartition ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 10001

SELECT n.nspname, p.proname, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid), p.prokind FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema') AND p.prokind IN ('f', 'p') ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 10001

SELECT table_schema, table_name, column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema') ORDER BY table_schema, table_name, ordinal_position LIMIT 10001

SELECT pid::text, usename, application_name, coalesce(client_addr::text, 'local'), coalesce(datname, ''), state, coalesce(wait_event_type || ': ' || wait_event, ''), EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - xact_start))::int, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - query_start))::int, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - state_change))::int, array_to_string(pg_blocking_pids(pid), ','), left(query, 400) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND backend_type = 'client backend' ORDER BY query_start NULLS LAST LIMIT 500

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend'), current_setting('max_connections')::int, (SELECT round(100.0 * sum(blks_hit) / nullif(sum(blks_hit) + sum(blks_read), 0), 1) FROM pg_stat_database), pg_is_in_recovery(), CASE WHEN NOT pg_is_in_recovery() THEN NULL WHEN pg_last_wal_receive_lsn() = pg_last_wal_replay_lsn() AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_stat_wal_receiver) THEN 0 ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp()))::int END
SELECT coalesce(application_name, ''), coalesce(client_addr::text, ''), coalesce(state, ''), round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM replay_lag)::numeric, 1) FROM pg_stat_replication

SELECT left(query, 300), calls, round(mean_time::numeric, 2), round((total_time / 1000)::numeric, 1), round((100 * total_time / nullif(sum(total_time) OVER (), 0))::numeric, 1) FROM pg_stat_statements ORDER BY total_time DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT left(query, 300), calls, round(mean_exec_time::numeric, 2), round((total_exec_time / 1000)::numeric, 1), round((100 * total_exec_time / nullif(sum(total_exec_time) OVER (), 0))::numeric, 1) FROM pg_stat_statements ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT n.nspname, c.relname, a.attnum::text, a.attname, COALESCE((SELECT k.n FROM pg_index i, unnest(i.indkey::int2[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, n) WHERE i.indrelid = c.oid AND i.indisprimary AND k.attnum = a.attnum AND k.n <= i.indnkeyatts), 0)::text, CASE WHEN c.relkind = 'p' OR (c.relkind = 'r' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_inherits h WHERE h.inhparent = c.oid)) THEN '1' ELSE '0' END FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped WHERE c.oid = 16384 ORDER BY a.attnum

SELECT indexrelid::regclass::text, (SELECT string_agg(a.attname, ',' ORDER BY k.n) FROM unnest(i.indkey) WITH ORDINALITY k(attnum, n) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = i.indrelid AND a.attnum = k.attnum) FROM pg_index i WHERE i.indrelid = '"app"."orders"'::regclass
SELECT * FROM "app"."update" LIMIT 100
EXPLAIN (VERBOSE, FORMAT JSON) SELECT * FROM t
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, VERBOSE, FORMAT JSON) SELECT * FROM t
SELECT DATABASE()
SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE, TABLE_ROWS FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 10001

SELECT ROUTINE_SCHEMA, ROUTINE_NAME, '', ROUTINE_TYPE FROM information_schema.ROUTINES WHERE ROUTINE_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 10001

SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, COLUMN_TYPE FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION LIMIT 10001

SELECT p.ID, p.USER, '', p.HOST, coalesce(p.DB, ''), p.COMMAND, coalesce(p.STATE, ''), TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, t.trx_started, NOW()), p.TIME, p.TIME, '', LEFT(coalesce(p.INFO, ''), 400) FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST p LEFT JOIN information_schema.INNODB_TRX t ON t.trx_mysql_thread_id = p.ID WHERE p.ID <> CONNECTION_ID() AND p.COMMAND NOT IN ('Daemon', 'Binlog Dump') ORDER BY p.TIME DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT r.PROCESSLIST_ID, b.PROCESSLIST_ID FROM performance_schema.data_lock_waits w JOIN performance_schema.threads r ON r.THREAD_ID = w.REQUESTING_THREAD_ID JOIN performance_schema.threads b ON b.THREAD_ID = w.BLOCKING_THREAD_ID
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST), @@max_connections, NULL, NULL, NULL
SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN ('Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_reads')
SHOW REPLICA STATUS

SELECT LEFT(DIGEST_TEXT, 300), COUNT_STAR, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000, 2), ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT / 1000000000000, 1), ROUND(100 * SUM_TIMER_WAIT / NULLIF(SUM(SUM_TIMER_WAIT) OVER (), 0), 1) FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE DIGEST_TEXT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT r.trx_mysql_thread_id, b.trx_mysql_thread_id FROM information_schema.INNODB_LOCK_WAITS w JOIN information_schema.INNODB_TRX r ON r.trx_id = w.requesting_trx_id JOIN information_schema.INNODB_TRX b ON b.trx_id = w.blocking_trx_id

SELECT ID, USER, '', HOST, coalesce(DB, ''), COMMAND, coalesce(STATE, ''), NULL, TIME, TIME, '', LEFT(coalesce(INFO, ''), 400) FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST WHERE ID <> CONNECTION_ID() AND COMMAND NOT IN ('Daemon', 'Binlog Dump') ORDER BY TIME DESC LIMIT 500
ANALYZE SELECT * FROM t
EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM t

SELECT c.TABLE_SCHEMA, c.TABLE_NAME, c.COLUMN_NAME, c.COLUMN_NAME, COALESCE((SELECT k.ORDINAL_POSITION FROM information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE k WHERE k.TABLE_SCHEMA = c.TABLE_SCHEMA AND k.TABLE_NAME = c.TABLE_NAME AND k.COLUMN_NAME = c.COLUMN_NAME AND k.CONSTRAINT_NAME = 'PRIMARY'), 0), COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN e.ENGINE = 'InnoDB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM information_schema.TABLES e WHERE e.TABLE_SCHEMA = c.TABLE_SCHEMA AND e.TABLE_NAME = c.TABLE_NAME), 0) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS c WHERE c.TABLE_SCHEMA = 'shop' AND c.TABLE_NAME = 'orders' ORDER BY c.ORDINAL_POSITION
SELECT INDEX_NAME, GROUP_CONCAT(COLUMN_NAME ORDER BY SEQ_IN_INDEX) FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'app' AND TABLE_NAME = 'orders' GROUP BY INDEX_NAME
SELECT * FROM `app`.`update` LIMIT 100
